prd_facts.fact: Customers that are not VIP (regular) have a maximum total discount of 20% of the subtotal.
VIP customers keep a maximum total discount of 30% of the subtotal.
The VIP discount stays 15% and the coupon percentage and how discounts add up do not change; only the ceiling changes.
A non-VIP customer whose discount is 20% or lower is not affected; a non-VIP with a 30% or 50% coupon gets exactly 20% off.
Rounding is unchanged: half up to cents.
Applies to every order from now on, with no flag and no migration.
